title: BT-GN-01 – Loss of containment of the HP / MP natural gas system (Hadeed gas network example)
description: Threats with frequencies, conditional probabilities and barrier PFDs are illustrative. Threat T1 frequency = demand gate of fault tree FT-GN-01 and its barrier = FT-GN-01 gate G-002; the ESD barrier = FT-GN-02 gate G-001. The top-event frequency is the initiating frequency of event tree ETA-GN-01, and consequences 1–3 reproduce its end states. HAZOP N01–N03, N07, N08; FMECA S01–S03, S08.
hazard: Natural gas at 7–42 barg in the GRMS, PRS-1 and MP ring main (extremely flammable, asphyxiant)
top: Loss of containment of natural gas from the HP / MP gas system

threats.name: PRS-1 active regulator fails open – MP header overpressure
threats.notes: Frequency = demand gate G-006 of fault tree FT-GN-01; 0.5 = probability that an MP overpressure (up to 42 barg on 10 barg design) causes a leak. HAZOP N02-02.

project.title: FT-GN-01 – PRS-1 overpressure of the MP header (Hadeed gas network example)
project.description: Top event: MP ring main pressure above its 10 barg design pressure because the PRS-1 active regulator fails open and the two independent overpressure protections – monitor regulator PCV-1103A (7.5 barg) and slam-shut SSV-1102A (OPSO 8.5 barg) – both fail. Gate G-002 = PFDavg of the PRS overpressure protection, used as a barrier in bow tie BT-GN-01 (threat T1). PSV-1105 is a token relief and is not credited. HAZOP N02-02 / N03-02; FMECA S02. Illustrative failure data – replace with site / vendor data before use. Part of the Hadeed gas network PHA worked example (HAZOP HZ-EX-GN-001).

project.title: FT-GN-02 – HP / MP gas detection and ESD isolation fails on demand (Hadeed gas network example)
project.description: Top event (gate G-001): a gas release in the GRMS / PRS-1 is not isolated – neither the automatic function (2oo3 gas detectors GD-1110A/B/C, SIS logic UCP-1000) nor the operator's manual ESD (HS-1000) initiates, or ESD valves ESDV-1001 / ESDV-1107 fail to close. PFDavg of G-001 is used as heading H2 of event tree ETA-GN-01 and as the mitigative ESD barrier of bow tie BT-GN-01. HAZOP N01-05, N02-05, N08-01…04; FMECA S01, S08. Illustrative failure data – replace with site / vendor data before use. Part of the Hadeed gas network PHA worked example (HAZOP HZ-EX-GN-001).
